setup.heading: Connected in under a minute
setup.sub: Add one URL to your AI tool's MCP configuration. No API key, no HERE account, no authentication.

steps.title: Add the server
steps.body: Add `https://docs.here.com/mcp` to your tool's MCP config as an HTTP server. Pick your client for the exact config.

steps.title: Test the connection
steps.body: Start a new chat and ask: "List the tools available from the HERE documentation MCP server."

steps.title: Build, and check the trace
steps.body: Ask for HERE code, then check the tool trace to confirm your agent used the MCP.

tabs.label: Claude Code
tabs.code:
# Add the HERE documentation MCP server
$ claude mcp add --transport http here-docs https://docs.here.com/mcp

# Check it is connected
$ claude mcp list

items.q: What is the HERE documentation MCP?
items.a: A documentation-focused MCP server that gives AI coding agents direct access to official HERE developer docs: guides, API references, data specs and changelogs. It is free and needs no HERE account.

items.q: Does it call HERE APIs or use my API key?
items.a: No. It reads public documentation only. It does not run HERE API requests, read credentials or create API keys. The code your agent writes needs a HERE API key to run.

items.q: Do I need a HERE account to use the MCP?
items.a: No. The server at https://docs.here.com/mcp needs no authentication. You need a HERE platform account only when you run the code your agent writes.

items.q: Why does getting an API key need a credit card?
items.a: HERE platform sign-up asks for a card before it issues an API key. [Product to confirm wording.] Not ready to add a card? Plan an evaluation with us.

items.q: Which AI coding tools does it work with?
items.a: Any client that supports HTTP MCP servers, including Claude, Cursor, Windsurf and Copilot.

items.q: How is it different from HERE Location Reasoning?
items.a: The documentation MCP helps your agent write HERE code. HERE Location Reasoning gives your agent live location tools while it runs: geocoding, routing, traffic and more.
